storage.stop_policy: Stop scheduling before estimated next atomic write/temporary peak would breach free50 GiB or owning stream80 GiB; if already below minimum stop immediately/safely preserve outputs. Reaching200 GiB alone is not a global hard stop. Re-estimate capacity and obtain resource decision if B cannot support planned envelope; never delete evidence to continue.
